invariants.rationale: Method expects strategyParams to be a valid map for lookup and configuration.
schema is passed as argument and likely required for partitioner creation; null schema would cause errors downstream.
strategyParams may be empty or may/may not contain specific keys; no guarantee on presence of clustering columns key.
All keys in a typical map should be non-null to avoid lookup exceptions.
A Map should not have null keys to avoid NullPointerExceptions during use.
